newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian bullion markets closed for Hindu festival.
newsitem.headline: Indian bullion markets closed for Hindu festival.

text.p: India's bullion markets were closed on Friday for a local Hindu festival, dealers said.
The markets reopen in Monday. Gold and silver trading have been curtailed to just two days this week with markets shut last Monday and Tuesday for local festivals.
On Thursday, gold prices ended higher on festival buying while silver eased on fresh inflows. Prices of a gold biscuit (116.50 grammes) rose by 100 rupees at 60,050 per piece.
Traders said about 1,500/2,000 kg of imported silver arrived on Thursday depressing prices. They said silver prices were likely to continue its fall next week.
